{{Quote|I already have one of our best starships waiting for you at the spaceport. Your astromech droid is prepping it for takeoff.|General Suthra|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] owned a '''''Defender''-class light corvette''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Gifted to the Knight by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class corvette]] served as the home and mobile base of the Hero and the five other crew members that would join the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] throughout the Knight's travels.
